forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 28 of July, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 1 zone survey and 3 visits; there were no technical surveys or clearances. So far, 20 zones have been surveyed, 6 declared free, 16 areas released and 8 areas cleared.

Officer attention: 13 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. No new plan was approved; the plan is P07.

The forecast made in week 27 covers the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already. It gives a range of 11 to 15 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 10 zones declared free.
